First, 20 weeks = 20 × 7 = 140 days.  
Add 5 days → total added = 145 days.  

Start date: 1704-08-29 (Gregorian).  
1704 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
August has 31 days, so from Aug 29 to Aug 31 → 2 days used.  
Remaining days to add: 145 − 2 = 143 days.  

September 1704 has 30 days → 143 − 30 = 113 left.  
October has 31 days → 113 − 31 = 82 left.  
November has 30 days → 82 − 30 = 52 left.  
December has 31 days → 52 − 31 = 21 left.  
Now in 1705 (not leap year, 1705 not divisible by 4).  

January 1705 has 31 days → 21 − 31 = negative, so stop before subtracting all of January.  
21 days into January 1705: January 1 + 20 days = January 21.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1705-01-21
